description: Check whether a NEAR package, crate, repository, RPC method, protocol feature, config key or hosted service is deprecated, removed or changed, and what to use instead, with the source and date of every claim. Pass the name as code or a config uses it: "near-sdk-js", "@near-wallet-selector/core", "near-lake-framework", "DelegateV2", "EXPERIMENTAL_tx_status", "near/near-cli", "rpc.testnet.pagoda.co". Use before writing or reviewing NEAR code that names a package or API from memory. NEAR only: for packages of other chains use their own tools.

name.description: Package, crate, repository (owner/repo or GitHub URL), RPC method, identifier, config key or endpoint host.
